text:
Jules R.: Quick follow-up from the 03/18 tail-latency postmortem. We need to lock owners for remediation items and decide how to treat the SLO window while we roll fixes.
Priya S.: I can take the runtime side (hot-shard KV eviction and trace annotation). ETA 72h for a staged fix + perf run.
Darin L.: Ill own autoscaling rules and dashboard changes. Plan: add a short burst counter, shorten scale-up cooldown from 60s -> 20s, and add an internal buffered SLO tile. ETA 48h.
Jules R.: For SLO handling: do NOT change the public SLO. Instead create an internal "buffered SLO" at 280ms for ops/error-budget math for 14 days, and tag the incident window on the public dashboard. That keeps customers' agreements intact but prevents oncall from burning dry.
Priya S.: Agreed. Ill include the dashboard flag in my PR. Also will attach synthetic perf results.
Darin L.: Draft alert tweak for ops (staging only):
```
alert: BufferedP95Breach
expr: service:inference_p95_ms > 280
for: 5m
labels: {severity: "page"}
annotations: {runbook: "https://go/redwood/runbooks/kv-hotspot"}
```
Ill push to staging dashboards and update the public dashboard with the incident note.
OncallBot: Incident 2026-03-18 | error budget impact: 4.2% | current p95: 312ms | incident link: https://go/redwood/incident/2026-0318
Jules R.: Action owners: Priya -> runtime PR + perf (3d), Darin -> autoscale + dashboard (2d), Jules -> canary plan + rollback conditions (1d). Add ETAs to the postmortem ticket and tag @oncall for the rollout window.
Priya S.: PR draft: https://git.redwood/runtime/pulls/1510 - includes eviction tweak and trace annotations. Perf job running now, will post results.
Darin L.: Autoscale PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/1043 - adds burst counter and cooldown change. Staging tile: https://dash.redwood/s/ops/p95-buffered. Canary ready once runtime patch lands.
Jules R.: Canary checklist: (1) update internal SLO doc, (2) canary = 5% traffic, (3) rollback if p95 > 350ms for 10m or error-rate +0.5%. Scheduling tentative canary 10:00 UTC tomorrow.
Priya S.: Perf run shows ~17% tail improvement under synthetic load. Will finalize patch in the morning.
Darin L.: Ill notify CS for the public dashboard incident note and coordinate on the customer-facing timeline.
Jules R.: Thanks team. We'll regroup after canary to decide whether to keep the buffered SLO for the 14-day window or restore normal thresholds. Logging closure items in the postmortem ticket now. :thumbsup:
